evidence.reason: The current implementation still calls `git fetch origin <branch>` without an empty `--refmap=`. Git uses the remote's configured fetch refspecs to map command-line refs to local refs, so a configuration such as `remote.origin.fetch=+refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main` can force-update local `main` even though the command's explicit refspec has no destination. The existing protected-ref check only sees explicit destinations, so this is a real bypass of the intended guard. The proposed fix is the smallest compatible change: pin `--refmap=` on these fetches and allow that option in safeArgs, applying it to `fetchRef` as well.
